description: This file is an implementation of a cache write platform service using JPA repository pattern in a Java-based project. It manages cache switching and configuration updates for the application.

classes.name: CacheWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing cache switching functionality, annotated as a Spring @Service, managing cache type changes and configuration persistence.

methods.name: switchToCache
methods.description: Switches the cache type used by the application, updates configuration if changes are made, and returns a map of changes.
